decisions.title: 選定 fresh answer pairs 保留輸入
decisions.passive: sorted 只新建外層 list；本文在更新 end slot 前新建 answer pair，避免與 input 共用 mutation。

decisions.oracle: It creates a fresh two-item answer list before later endpoint updates, so those updates do not modify an input pair.

decisions.title: 取得非遞減 starts 再套 merge rule

decisions.title: 保留群組最遠 right endpoint
decisions.passive: 對已排序且重疊的下一段保留 left、取 max right；只記 previous original end 或直接指定 end 可能縮掉覆蓋。
decisions.active_cue: Why retain the maximum end of the whole group?
decisions.oracle: A contained interval must not shrink existing coverage, and the next gap test needs the entire group's farthest endpoint.

decisions.title: strict gap 使前段定案
decisions.passive: nondecreasing starts 讓 gap 後的 future starts 都在右側；前面已定案各段不需重查。
decisions.active_cue: Why does a strict gap finalize the previous group?
decisions.oracle: With nondecreasing starts, every later start is beyond that group's right endpoint, so none can bridge the gap.

decisions.title: merged pair 表示 processed connected group

decisions.active_cue: Why is the first endpoint lookup safe?

decisions.title: 先固定 n、k 與 elementary costs
decisions.passive: 有界端點與固定 pair 允許常數比較、reference 讀寫與 pair 建立；Big O 是成長上界。

decisions.title: 分開 scan 計數與 append aggregate
decisions.passive: n 次 scan 各有固定上限的讀寫比較；append 擴容另外合計，不能由一行 append 推出單次常數。

decisions.title: 按 append 序列合計複製
decisions.passive: 固定比例的過去容量形成幾何上界，C=O(k) 加 k 次寫入推出總 O(k)，不保證個別 append worst-case constant。

decisions.title: 區分概念 merge 與 CPython schedule
decisions.passive: balanced plan 解釋每層線性乘對數層數；本文另用 Powersort 層級計費與有界 run extension 連到 CPython 最壞界。
decisions.active_cue: Why does the balanced merge model yield n log n work?
decisions.oracle: A merge advances through its a+b items once; one level totals O(n), and O(log n) doubling levels give O(n log n).

decisions.title: 分開 output、ordered 與 sorting workspace
decisions.passive: output 的 k 組 fresh pairs 為 O(k)；n key slots 加可重用的至多 2m merge slots 與 pending records 為 O(n) sorting workspace。sort cleanup 後 scan 留 ordered 與 result；list.sort 只去掉 outer copy，不消除 workspace。
decisions.active_cue: Why does in-place sorting not establish constant auxiliary space?
decisions.oracle: Removing the separate outer list leaves sorting workspace: n key-reference slots, a reused smaller-run merge buffer and pending-run records can still scale with n.

decisions.title: repeated selection 用重新搜尋換順序
decisions.passive: used markers 選剩餘最小 start 保留 merge 正確性，但每輪重掃造成平方工作且仍留 n 個 markers。
decisions.oracle: Checking n markers on each of n selections gives n squared checks; scanning only remaining candidates still sums to n(n+1)/2.

decisions.title: 可靠 sorted-input contract 才移除 ordering
decisions.passive: 去除 ordered 與 sort workspace，沿用同一 merge 與 append aggregate：O(n) time、O(1) auxiliary，另外保留 O(k) output。
decisions.active_cue: What permits the sorted-input adaptation and what storage remains?
decisions.oracle: A reliable nondecreasing-start guarantee permits skipping ordering; the same scan takes O(n) time with O(1) auxiliary state excluding its O(k) result.

decisions.title: 面試成本回答保留模型與空間邊界
decisions.passive: 用已推導的 CPython sort、scan/append 與 output-excluded auxiliary 成本作簡短回答，不把它當新證明。

List append needs an aggregate argument. A Python list stores references in an array with some spare slots. Most appends fill one spare slot.
